## Problem
When the same incident is reported through multiple channels, the Keelwater system creates duplicate claims without warning staff. This splits reserves and confuses adjustments because duplicates go undetected.

## Who is affected
- **Motor and auto insurers** are affected, with Pendleford Motor Mutual stating the system doesn’t alert them when a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal [i:037d7fd88bdfe192].
- **Home and fleet insurers** are also affected, with Hollinbrook Home Insurance and Orrinbury Fleet Insurance reporting the same issue where no system warning appears, creating duplicate records [i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:98da20d057061932].
- **Support teams** bear the operational burden, as Tarnholt Drive Cover reports manually cross-checking every new claim to avoid duplicates, which eats up time [i:82e08d8615bf7651].

## Evidence
The issue has been raised by 7 accounts across all 3 customer-facing routes: onboarding, sales, and support [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:72656010c210a80e]. There have been 15 total mentions of the problem [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:2b2412a21ba06c15][i:603ee96296d14553][i:72656010c210a80e][i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:7d53d00296e4475f][i:82e08d8615bf7651][i:847e58c1a543471c][i:8ec45cfe56e665e5][i:98da20d057061932][i:dadf780eadfacb5e][i:e662b0d940a820b4][i:f0ce1c1992e87bd2].
- **Onboarding feedback**: During implementation, Callowfield Auto Assurance noted the system doesn’t show any warning at intake, which leads to duplicate records and inaccurate reserves [i:2b2412a21ba06c15].
- **Sales feedback**: Sallowmere Motor reported that the same incident came in both by phone and through the portal, resulting in two separate claims with no alert to flag it [i:0990586a589ee5d4].
- **Support tickets**: Ravensgill Insurance stated they are getting the same claim twice when a policyholder reports via phone and then the portal, with no alert popping up at intake [i:dadf780eadfacb5e]. Tarnholt Drive Cover mentioned they have to manually link duplicates after the fact, which delays payments and reporting [i:8ec45cfe56e665e5]. Orrinbury Fleet Insurance also cited disabled UI buttons that should allow linking but don’t work [i:e662b0d940a820b4].

The affected accounts represent a significant portion of revenue. The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from accounts with data is GBP 5,220,000.00 [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:2b2412a21ba06c15][i:72656010c210a80e][i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:98da20d057061932][i:dadf780eadfacb5e]. This includes Pendleford Motor Mutual (ARR GBP 690,000.00) [i:037d7fd88bdfe192], Callowfield Auto Assurance (ARR GBP 1,250,000.00) [i:2b2412a21ba06c15], Tarnholt Drive Cover (ARR GBP 290,000.00) [i:72656010c210a80e], Hollinbrook Home Insurance (ARR GBP 2,400,000.00) [i:7572aacb13bfbab0], Orrinbury Fleet Insurance (ARR GBP 120,000.00) [i:98da20d057061932], and Ravensgill Insurance (ARR GBP 470,000.00) [i:dadf780eadfacb5e].

## Why now
Customer mentions have been consistent and recent, spanning from 2026-09-12 to 2026-10-31 [i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:f0ce1c1992e87bd2]. The issue is actively impacting operations, as evidenced by ongoing support tickets. Furthermore, 0 renewals have occurred in the last 90 days, indicating a potential risk to customer retention and contract renewals if the problem persists. Several key accounts, including Tarnholt Drive Cover (renewal 2027-01-09) and Hollinbrook Home Insurance (renewal 2027-01-15), have upcoming renewals soon [i:72656010c210a80e][i:7572aacb13bfbab0].
</previous_draft>
